Third-party programs and data bundled with FiberBrowser
=======================================================

Besides the Python packages (their licences are in their own folders), the
FiberBrowser app and its Windows (WSL) distribution bundle:

minimap2 2.31
    Heng Li. MIT licence (minimap2-LICENSE.txt).
    https://github.com/lh3/minimap2

BLAST+: blastn and makeblastdb only
    National Center for Biotechnology Information. NCBI's code is public
    domain, a "United States Government Work".
    Mac app: BLAST+ 2.17.0, NCBI's macOS release binaries, unchanged
    (BLAST-LICENSE.txt holds NCBI's notice). They statically include
    third-party libraries under their own licences: LMDB (OpenLDAP Public
    License), Mbed TLS (Apache-2.0), nghttp2 and libuv (MIT). Details and
    licence texts: BLAST-THIRD-PARTY.txt.
    Windows (WSL) distribution (ncbi-blast+ 2.12.0):
    BLAST+ and its dependencies come from Debian bookworm packages; sources at https://sources.debian.org / snapshot.debian.org
    Each package's copyright file is in /usr/share/doc/<package>/copyright.
    https://blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/doc/blast-help/downloadblastdata.html
    FiberBrowser runs it with BLAST_USAGE_REPORT=false (NCBI's opt-out of
    BLAST+ usage reporting) unless you set that variable yourself.
    Camacho C et al. BLAST+: architecture and applications.
    BMC Bioinformatics 10:421 (2009).

D. melanogaster TE canonical sequence set v10.2 (FASTA + GFF3)
    Bergman lab / FlyBase. CC0 1.0 (drosophila-transposons-LICENSE.txt).
    https://github.com/bergmanlab/drosophila-transposons
